gaps.lead: The concert was cancelled because hardly anybody came.
gaps.sentence: The concert was cancelled ___ people came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.

gaps.lead: The doctor persuaded me to promise that I would exercise daily.
gaps.sentence: The doctor ___ that I would exercise daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = persuade/make them.

gaps.lead: He jogged every morning when he was younger.
gaps.sentence: He ___ every morning when he was younger.
gaps.explanation: 'Used to + infinitive' describes a past habit.

gaps.lead: I don't expect the company to make a profit this year, given the economic climate.
gaps.sentence: Given the economic climate, ___ the company made a profit this year.
gaps.hint: don't expect = would be surprised if + past
gaps.explanation: A tentative prediction: 'I would be surprised if + past simple'.

gaps.lead: The play was so boring that we left early.
gaps.explanation: 'So boring' becomes 'such a boring play that …'.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.
